facts.fact: The CNPD's members took office on 24 April 2015 and its president declared it installed on 10 December 2015.
The CNPD says the personal data protection legal regime was amended on 17 March 2021, adding breach notification and impact assessments.

facts.fact: The CNPD says that from 2015 to 2025 it issued thousands of authorisations and hundreds of opinions and received hundreds of complaints.
